unmeasured..claude/hooks/gate-git-diff.sh: A PreToolUse hook run by Claude Code, not by anything the suite imports, and bash rather than Python -- coverage.py has nothing to instrument here. It is not unexercised: tests/test_git_diff_gate.py runs this exact script as a subprocess against real tool payloads and asserts exit 2 for each spelling that reads or writes an arbitrary file, exit 0 for the ordinary forms, and a fail-closed refusal when jq is absent.
unmeasured.Containerfile: Executes only inside an image build. Nothing on the host reaches it, so there is no seam to measure. Its happy path runs on every build.yml and build-pr.yml run; its failure branches do not.
unmeasured.build_files/build-image.sh: Same: a RUN step in the Containerfile, against a real RPM database and module tree. It does its work at the top level, so sourcing it would execute the whole file. The decisions it delegates -- ZFS install, signing policy -- live in the Python modules above, which are measured. One decision it makes itself, pinning crun-krun to the base image's crun version-release, is not unexercised: tests/test_architecture_overview_doc.py runs those lines under the script's own strict mode with rpm and dnf5 stubbed. Its two brew checks, check_brew_login_fragments and check_brew_setup_staging, are functions that tests/test_build_image_brew_fragments.py and tests/test_build_image_brew_setup_staging.py extract and run against fixture trees.
unmeasured.files/etc/profile.d/brew-path.sh: Sourced by a login shell on a booted machine, not by anything on the host or in the suite. tests/test_build_image_brew_fragments.py runs its text under bash against a fixture prefix and asserts it is owner-gated, uses no command substitution, and executes nothing out of the Homebrew prefix.
